_note: Fins subsystem (FIN) local numbers, owner D3, design R6 (D-146/D-147; R5 CR-A1-63; CHANGE-LOG D-26/27/28/42/48/51/52/54/61/68/70). Read by fusion/fins.py (ctx.local), make_fins.py and team/D3/fins_calcs.py (P:fin_detail.*); C4, C6 and E3 read some keys too: never rename a key. Shared numbers (fin station, tube x, tube OD/ID and length, half height, TE, motor height, cant, board thickness, layers, spar) come from params/params.json; tube_length_m and layers are copies for the C4/C6 readers and fins.py checks they agree. Frame: params.json#frame (metres, x aft, y right, z up).

tube_length_m.note: copy of the shared key for the C4/C6 readers; fins.py reads params.json#fins.tube.length_m and checks they agree

bond_gap_m.note: radial gap of every printed bore on the motor tube (bore = tube OD + 0.30 mm: 22.40 mm on the Rock West 35046-S at OD 22.10 EST, D-147; was 22.3 mm on the 22 mm CF tube); filled with 30 min epoxy. Unchanged by D-147: the bores follow fins.tube.od_m (fins.py r_b = r_t + bond_gap)

width_m.note: spanwise, centred on the fin plane; C4 sizes the tube-bore shear-out at 36 mm (CL-C4-BLOCK-MS 0.47); core cut-out (CR-D3-03 to D1)

wall_m.note: PETG wall ahead of the tube bore and behind the spar bore (C4: 6 mm outside each bore)

x_split_m.note: boundary between the flat-topped tube socket (ahead) and the airfoil-contoured spar saddle (aft); mid-web between the bores (web 12.8 mm)

edge_r_m.note: R5: the block four vertical (plan-form) edges rounded R 3 mm: front corners on the tube socket (x0), aft corners on the spar saddle (x1). D1 cuts the core pocket to the same radius and lays >= 3 mm microballoon beads along the pocket edges (C2 CL-C2-FEA-FOAM-CORNER-S1/-S3)

fill_factor.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/A3.md#1.2 L2 (A3 S04): 2 perimeters + 10 % gyroid, -6.9 g per FIN-004
fill_factor.note: 3 perimeters + 15 % gyroid on a 40 x 65 x 30 mm block; weigh the first print | L2 (closure round): 0.55 -> 0.449 so each FIN-004 drops 39.95 -> 33.05 g (A3 -13.8 g for two). REQUEST to C4 (CL-C4-D3-BLOCK-MS, ASM-C4-BLOCK-FILL about 0.46 EST) and C2 (corner FEA block modulus) to confirm; if either rejects, set back to 0.55 (+13.8 g)

le_gap_m.note: board LE to tube surface, filled by the epoxy fillet

adhesive_kgm2.note: spray adhesive between the two board layers (3M 77 class, ~15 g/m2 wet)

root_joint_g.note: R4: skin-tape laps only (15 mm up both faces x 0.26 m, ~50 g/m2 packing tape). The fillets are now CAD bodies (root_fillet) with their own density; was 3.0 g for fillets + laps, which under-counted the fillet volume about four times

top_edge.value: straight line from the station-collar top at the LE to the half height at the step front (x 0.2614), then a vertical cut down to the flat step at |z| 0.2010 to the TE
top_edge.note: the edge strips run along the sloped part and end at the square tip; the LE-top corner is notched for the collar tongue (station_collar.tail_m)

tip_square_m.note: Closure round (D5 1.2 / 1.3, shoe depth 7.0 mm): square tip x 0.2510-0.320 (69.0 mm) = te - CL-D5-FIN-STEP-X; the sloped top edge reaches the half height at x 0.2510, the tip is cut down to the flat step (tip_step_z_m) from there to the TE; strips end at x 0.2510 and meet the step front; pins stop before the shoe cheeks (tip_clear_x_m). CL-D3-TIP-STEP-MISMATCH (<= 0.5 mm) guards the copy. Was 0.0586 (D-75, step front 0.2614)

tip_step_z_m.note: |z| of the flat step edge, 7.0 mm below the 0.21 m half height (D5 closure shoe depth 7.0 mm); the D5 shoe sits on it. Was 0.2010 (D-75)

tip_clear_x_m.note: nothing of D3 but the laminate and the strip ends on x >= 0.2432 (D5 closure shoe collar cheeks x 0.2432-0.2512, 7.8 mm ahead of the step front): the last pin ends before it. Was 0.2536

leg_m.note: D-92: 15 -> 10 mm cove, both faces, ahead of the hinge; no strength credit (the fin is sized root-free, CL-C4-D3-MS-FACE-ROOT-FREE; intact share 0.8 %, CL-C4-D3-FILLET-L4-SHARE). 10 mm, not 6, because the fillet mass aft of the CG holds the forward CG limit for the 590 g pack (CL-A1-PACK-CG-FWD +0.13 mm; -0.82 mm at 6 / 6 mm)

leg_aft_m.note: D-92: kept at 13 mm aft of the hinge (elevon end gap 2.2 mm): the aft fillet is the cheapest mass that holds the forward CG limit after the 15 -> 10 mm cut ahead of the hinge

leg_fwd_m.note: sealing fillet from the boss tail to the start of the effective length (no strength credit in CL-D3-ROOT-FILLET-RF or CL-C6-FIN-ROOT-RF). R4b: 6 -> 4 mm (-1.5 g for four roots, mass action CR-A3-26); the 15 mm tape laps still seal the root, the wire hole clears it further

release_x_m.note: D-179 (C2 closure round), shortened by release_end_x_m: the half-fin root, its coves and the 15 mm skin-tape laps bond to the wing for x < 0.22 and again for x > release_end_x_m (0.27); from x 0.22 to 0.27 (50 mm) they sit on a release film and are free (203 of the 253 mm root bonded, 80 %). 30 mm (10 R) ahead of the elevon cut-out corners. Cove sizes (10 mm ahead of the hinge, 13 aft) and the fillet mass unchanged. C4 re-checks the station modes (CL-C4-D3-SEP, -SEP-WHIRL)

release_end_x_m.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/C4.md (final re-run: release 0.22 to 0.27, TE 0.27-0.30 stays bonded)
release_end_x_m.note: Closure-round fix for the station-mode separation (C4): the release film ends at x 0.27, so the last 30 mm of the root (and its coves and tape laps) stays bonded to the wing; the TE end is what restrains the fin panel in the fore-aft station mode (releasing 0.22-0.27 costs 1 Hz, releasing the TE end 15 Hz). Film length 50 mm, 4 strips of 50 x 45 mm. 40 mm (4 R) aft of the elevon cut-out corners at 0.2496 is NOT kept: the bonded tab ends at the wing TE x 0.30, so C2 re-checks corner compression

release_film_w_m.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/C2.md#D3 request 3 (about 45 mm wide in all, centred on the fin plane)
release_film_w_m.note: film width: the 4.8 mm fin plus both 13 mm coves is 30.8 mm; 45 mm leaves 7 mm each side. One 48 mm packing-tape strip laid sticky side down (45 mm used) replaces C2's two overlapping 25.4 mm PTFE strips

release_film_t_m.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/C2.md#D3 request 3 (100 x 45 x 0.13 mm bodies)
release_film_t_m.note: modelled envelope of the film body; the root and coves sit on top of it (0.13 mm higher over x 0.22-TE, inside the bond-line tolerance). A real 48 mm packing tape is about 0.05 mm: the 0.13 mm is conservative (C2's PTFE + adhesive figure)

release_film_areal_kgm2.note: EST: one layer of the wing's own 48 mm packing tape (BOPP film + acrylic adhesive), 0.065 kg/m2; 4 strips of 100 x 45 mm = 1.2 g. C2's PTFE was 1.2 g each (4.9 g). Chosen as the cheapest release film (BUILD step 11 note): epoxy does not bond to BOPP (West System / Epoxyworks: plastic packaging tape is a release; polyethylene and polypropylene are solvent-proof soft plastics epoxy will not stick to). Weigh the strips

eff_len_m.note: bonded root length from the TE forward that carries the full fillet (the foot side load enters at the TE tip); the lower roots skip the D6 slot, so their full fillet starts further forward

gcc.note: R5 lever (CR-A1-63, D-63 "D3 returns what its levers give"): 0.55 -> 0.45 g/cm3, a light non-sag mix (phenolic or low-density glass microballoons, about 3 : 1 by volume to laminating epoxy, <= 3 % colloidal silica). Acceptance: a cured 20 cm3 cup weighs <= 9.0 g (T-D3-WEIGH) before any fillet is laid; if it reads higher, use the lightest mix that stays non-sag and report the mass (fallback lever: block fill, C4). Strength is not set by the filler: the root joint fails in the paper face (0.10 MPa) or the XPS (0.125 MPa allowable), and the fillet is credited fail-safe only (D-68). Was 0.55 (~2 : 1 glass)

stop_over_link_slot.note: lower roots: no fillet over the link slot x 0.2376-0.2616 (both faces), else the 1/8 in rod hits it

half_width_m.note: notch in the LOWER half-fin root centred on the elevon hinge line (x = c (1 - elevon chord_frac)), for D6's inter-panel link (CR-A4-04); D6 confirms the sweep

grip_m.note: D-91: 12 -> 18 mm. The slit-collar foundation (E / t_wall) d l^3 / 12 was the stiffness cap (3 168 N m/rad at 12 mm, below the 2 229 N m/rad need in series with any body); 18 mm gives 10 692. The lip cap still sits on the tube end; the mount collar now reaches down to |z| 0.154 and the station collar sits 6 mm lower (top |z| 0.1535). Was 12 mm (CALC-D3-MOUNT-SLIP)

cap_t_m.note: D-173: 2.5 -> 1.5 mm to hold cap-to-tube-end 0 with the 25 mm pattern (tube length shared). FLAG for C4 (CL-C4-D3-MS-CAP-G3 was 58.6 at 2.5 mm) and C6

cap_lip_r_m.note: inner radius of the lip: covers the tube wall (RW 35046-S inner radius 9.525 mm, wall ~1.53 mm at OD 22.10 EST, D-147; was the 1 mm wall of the 22 x 20 tube). C4: G3 cap margin 37.2 -> 58.6 (CL-C4-D3-MS-CAP-G3)

head_clear_m.note: D-173: clearance from the lowest washer edge (not the head) to the cap top; 2.5 mm hex key axis sits 12.5 mm below the motor centre, its lower edge ~14.5 mm, 2 mm above the cap top, so the key still clears. Was 3.2 mm below a 5.5 mm head. Needed because the 25 mm pattern lowers the lowest washer edge 3.75 mm and the tube length (shared) stays 0.344

slit_m.note: collar split on the outboard side

ear_len_m.note: beyond the collar; pinch bolt M3x16 + nyloc along x

face_ahead_m.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/E1.md#D-173 applied s4 (CL-E1-FACE-AHEAD-FOR-CLR needs 3.0 mm; 1 mm over)
face_ahead_m.note: Closure round fix (C4): 4.0 -> 3.0 mm, E1's 25 mm blade-to-tube gap needs exactly 3.0 mm (zero margin, E1 to confirm), +1.5 Hz on the station mode. Closure round D-173: 12.0 -> 4.0 mm for the X2814 V3 / APC 11x8E at 10 deg (E1: 25 mm blade-to-tube gap needs 3.0 mm, 1.0 mm kept). Prop plane x = face - 47.7 mm cos 10 deg; collar-front gap = 4.0 + 46.98 = 51.0 mm >= 0.14 D 39.1 mm (B4 CR-B4-04). Was 12.0 (D-146, 9 deg), 14.0 contingency (D-164)

plate_t_m.note: R3: the whole motor plate is canted (front and back faces parallel to the motor face, 9 deg since D-146, was 7), uniform 4.5 mm under every screw head: M3x8 with the 2 x 0.5 mm washers (washer_stack_m 0.001) engages 8 - 4.5 - 1.0 = 2.5 mm at every hole whatever the cant (D-173; the 3.5 mm of the R3 text is without the washers) and the head bears flat (C6 CL-C6-MOTOR-HEAD-RF). Replaces the R2 flat plate + canted pads

plate_half_y_m.note: D-173: covers the inboard cheek outer face 14.3 + 5.4 = 19.7 mm + 0.3. Was 14.5

plate_half_z_m.note: D-173: washer edge 12.5 + 3.5 = 16.0 mm + 0.3 mm. Was 15.0

bolt_pattern_m.source: SunnySky X2814 drawing https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2024/0305/files/X2814.jpg (via E1.md D-173 applied s3, read 2026-11-14)
bolt_pattern_m.note: D-173: cross pattern, 4 x M3 on 19 mm (across y) and 25 mm (across z); which of the two is along which axis is not on the drawing (EST: 25 along z, as the 19 was on the X3108S); can 35 mm dia x 36 mm, holes 3.0 mm deep. The plate is printed with 2.5 mm square pilots and DRILLED 3.4 mm with the motor as template (C6 CR-C6-10: no slots)

shaft_hole_d_m.note: rear shaft and circlip clearance, printed as a 10 mm square opening in the canted plate; UNVERIFIED against the motor

cheek_t_m.note: C4 D-173 R8 (separation 0.208 knock-down needs cheeks +3.0 mm): outboard cheek 5.5 mm, grown outward. FLAG: C4 assumed inner faces 11.5 / 12.1 mm; D3 moved them out to 13.4 / 14.3 mm (washer + screw drift, see cheek_y_in_m), so C4 re-runs k_rock on the drawn mount. Was 0.0025

cheek_in_t_m.note: C4 D-173 R8: inboard cheek 5.4 mm, grown outward. Same FLAG as cheek_t_m. Was 0.0024

cheek_y_in_m.note: D-173: outboard cheek inner face from the fin plane; clears the M3 washer edge (9.5 + 3.5 = 13.0 mm) by 0.4 mm. Was 11.5

cheek_len_m.note: C4 D-173 R8: follows face_ahead (-10 mm): cheeks run 13.5 mm aft of the plate back face. Was 0.0235

cheek_slit_gap_m.note: D-80: the outboard (slit-side) cheek ends this far ahead of the slit front face (x_t - slit/2 - gap) so it joins only the front half of the collar and the front ear; the inboard cheek keeps the full cheek_len_m. Before D-80 the outboard cheek bridged the slit and both ears for the top 8.4 mm and the clamp could not close. Feeler-check the 1.5 mm slit on the first print

key_w_m.note: C6 closure round, D-164: arc length of the clocking dog at its mean radius r_b + 0.8 mm = 12.0 mm. The dog is an annular sector from r_b (11.2 mm) to r_b + ring_wall (12.8 mm), 47.7 deg, centred on -x, hanging from the mount collar's lower face. Hold RF 1.61 lower bound at the 10 deg design twist 0.406 N m. Was 0.003 (box, D-81)

key_d_m.note: depth of dog engagement into the station-collar notch (the dog also spans the 0.5 mm collar gap); D-164 (C6): kept, ASA face bearing RF 2.16

key_clear_m.note: per side between the dog and the notch walls (angular: key_clear / 12.0 mm = 0.95 deg), and under the dog tip; notch = 47.7 + 2 x 0.95 = 49.6 deg sector through the station-collar ring, floor key_d + key_clear = 2.7 mm below the ring top (C6.md 6.4)

prop_stack_m.note: D-173: mount face to prop mid-plane along the motor axis, X2814 V3 (body 36.0 + maker adapter base 6.5 EST + post + hub 10.41 + washer). Projection on x = stack cos(cant). Was 0.0373 (X3108S, D-51)

cant_sense_UR.note: R4: -1. The UR thrust side component points along -t = -(x_hat x r_hat): the UR prop end leans toward the wing plane (-z) and outboard (+y); every station follows by the quad mirrors (UL: outboard -y and -z; LR: +y and +z; LL: -y and +z). The R3 print (+1) reversed hover yaw. Prints A (UR, LL) and B (UL, LR) keep their station assignment; the plate geometry of each print changed. H1/H2 verify with an inclinometer and the hanging yaw test before the first hover (D-52)

slip_torque_nm.note: closure fix (C4): 2.5 -> 2.55 N m (CL-C4-D3-MS-MOUNT-SLIP needs 2.534 at C1's 1.451 N m); fuse rises 0.05 N m, inside C6's 6.55 N m cap. pinch-bolt setting: the collar turns on the tube at this torque (the D-23 fuse, side loads at the motor); set with a luggage scale (BUILD.md)

mu_petg_cf.note: ASA (was PETG) on matte CF, dry; key name kept for the E3/C6 readers; only used to estimate the bolt preload, the setting is measured (T-D3-SLIP)

fill_factor.note: 2-4.5 mm ASA walls print almost solid

hardware_g.note: M3x16 SHCS 1.0 + M3 nyloc 0.25 + 2 washers 0.15 per mount

pilot_m.note: square printed pilot at each motor-screw hole, drilled out to screw_hole_d_m

material.note: HDT 93 degC; motor base 66.4 degC steady hover (CL-E3-MOUNT-ASA); PETG fails by 8 K

cheek_in_y_in_m.note: D-173: inboard cheek inner face; washer edge 13.0 mm + 0.3 + the screw-axis drift toward this cheek (0.090 mm/mm at 10 deg over the 12 mm the screw travels) so the screws still come out whole. Bridged to the collar by a web (fins.py). Was 12.1

washer_d_m.source: ISO 7089 M3 (7 mm OD, 0.5 mm thick)
washer_d_m.note: D-173 (E1.md applied s1): M3x8 with 2 washers under the head; the washer, not the 5.5 mm head, sets the keep-clear below the screw pattern

washer_t_m.note: thickness of one motor-screw washer; washer_stack_m = washers_per_screw x washer_t_m (fins.py checks)

washers_per_screw.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/E1.md#D-173 (2 x 0.5 mm under each motor-screw head)
washers_per_screw.note: two M3 washers under each of the 4 x 4 motor screws (32 in all, BOM FIN-108); engagement = motor_screw_len_m - plate_t_m - washer_stack_m = 2.5 mm; C6 reads the same stack (ASM-C6-MOTOR-WASHER-STACK 1.0 mm)

washer_stack_m.source: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/E1.md#D-173 applied s1 (2 x ISO 7089, 0.5 mm each)
washer_stack_m.note: two M3 washers under each screw head; engagement = screw length - plate - washers

motor_hole_depth_m.source: X2814 base hole depth 3.0 mm (E1.md D-173 applied s3, maker drawing); probe on arrival (T-E1-MOTOR-RM)
motor_hole_depth_m.note: blind M3 holes in the can base; the screw tip must stay short of the bottom

x0_m.note: aft of the clip tails; ESC long axis along x (hover slipstream direction)

h_m.note: R4: 28 -> 31 mm so each strap slot inner edge is 10.5 mm from the pad centre and the 20 mm ESC (ASM-E3-ESC) clears both 3 mm slots (CL-E1-ESC-SLOT was 0.90)

z_m.note: |z| of the pad centre: 72 mm from the motor axis, inside the contracted slipstream and below the edge strip

slot_m.note: two strap slots (x by z) for a 10 mm hook-and-loop strap, cut through the board as well

slot_edge_m.note: strap slot edge to pad edge

material.note: ESC pad 61.6 degC (CL-E3-ESC-PEAK) against PETG 58 degC

cf_gcc.note: same basis as the spar's 0.102 kg/m

bond_g_per_joint.note: 30 min epoxy per clip or pad joint

block_bond_g.note: per block: tube bore + spar bore + core faces

fin_detail._note: Design R6 (D3, design round 2026-11-14 wave 2): R5 plus the 9 deg cant with face_ahead 12.0 mm and cheeks 21.5 mm (D-146), the Rock West 35046-S motor tube (bores follow fins.tube.od_m) and the CF 19 x 17 tube plug (D-147, A3 S01R). R5 (CR-A1-63): R4 plus face_ahead 7.5 mm and cheeks 17 mm (D-61), block vertical edges R 3 mm (D-68), pins 2.5 mm (D-70), collar 15 mm (D-70 13 mm; C6-R5 CR-C6-36), collar phase tie lug at x 0.060 open along x (CR-F2-16), fillet mix 0.45 g/cm3 (mass lever). R4 (CR-A1-47): R3 two-layer braced fin (D-26) with: cant sense reversed (D-52), motor face 2.5 mm ahead of the collar and E1 stack 37.3 mm (D-51), ESC pad 31 mm high (CR-E1-30), D5 tip step (D-54), 12 mm station collar (D-48, C4 CR-C4-25) and 15 mm root fillets modelled as CAD bodies (CR-C6-24), stopped over the D6 link slot (CR-D6-04). R3: two 4.8 mm boards laminated, CF 10 x 2 brace from the station collar to the spar, CF 10 x 1 edge strips pinned with 2 mm CF pins every 15 mm and anchored 40 mm in a two-face collar tail (C6), internal tube plug at the block, a strap eye on each block boss, ASA mounts (7 deg canted plate) and ESC pads (D-42).

layers.note: copy of the shared key for the C4/C6 readers (two 4.8 mm boards laminated, CL-C4-D3-SEP 0.41); one layer (CR-D3-02) rejected; fins.py reads params.json#fins.layers and checks they agree

od_m.note: D-147 / A3 S01R: CF 19 x 17 mm roll-wrapped tube, 53 mm, slides in the 19.05 mm bore of the Rock West 35046-S (radial gap ~0.025 mm; sand lightly if the bought OD is over 19.0, measure on arrival). Internal doubler over the full 47 mm bore (C4: internal plug at every bore). Listing: lindinger.at R&G 19 x 17 x 1000 mm 3K, EUR 29.78 (checked 2026-11-14; US listing for I1). Was the 20 x 18 offcut sanded to 19.9 mm in the 20 mm bore (D-147: the 20 x 18 does not enter the RW bore)

overhang_m.note: beyond the ends of the bore bosses

height_m.note: D-90: 15 -> 22 mm on the D-65 loads (C1 half-fin torsion 12.67 N m governs, CL-C6-COLLAR-L-REQ 19.45 mm): RF 1.13 (CL-C6-COLLAR-RF). Top 0.5 mm below the mount collar, which D-91 moved down 6 mm: ring |z| 0.1315-0.1535, ear mid 0.1475. Was 15 (R5b), 13 (D-70), 12 (D-48), 16 (R3)

slot_wall_m.note: R3: tail outer walls 3 perimeters (bond face for the strip outer face only)

tail_m.note: R3: two-face tail 40 mm aft of the tube surface (>= 33.7 mm, CL-C6-STRIP-EMBED-REQ): a solid tongue of board thickness fills the notched LE-top corner of the board, the strips lie in slots between the tongue and two outer walls, joined by a cap over the top edge; slots open downward

ear_len_m.note: inboard of the collar; holds the brace end in a 3.3 x 10.4 mm slot, 10 mm deep

ear_w_m.note: along x; 2.8 mm walls either side of the 10.4 mm brace slot

ear_h_m.note: brace ear height, flush with the collar top: brace end at |z| 0.1535 as accepted by C4

cap_t_m.note: cap over the strip tops joining tongue and walls (3 perimeters)

strip_slot_clear_m.note: per side, strip in its tail slot (epoxy gap)

material.note: at ambient, 30 mm below the motor plate

tongue_fill.note: tail tongue (9.6 mm thick): 3 perimeters (1.2 mm) under each strip face + 20 % gyroid core; the faces carry the bond, the tail carries ~1 350 N design tension at ~14 MPa over walls + cap + tongue perimeters (C6 re-checks, CR-D3-17); weigh the first print

tongue_depth_m.note: tongue and walls reach this far below the strip band (strip 10 mm wide + 1 mm), not the full 16 mm ring height: the board notch is only as deep as the strip

w_m.note: pultruded CF strip 10 mm wide (10 x 2, brace.t_m), 10 mm side along x (cruise flow); C4-R3 sizing sheet

t_m.note: R3: 10 x 2 mm strip, accepted by C4 on the D3 geometry (P_cr 293 N vs 166 N design, separation 0.39 with two layers; the brace stores 2-6 % of the modal strain energy, so its stiffness hardly matters); saves 9 g against 10 x 3

anchor_y_m.note: |y| of the anchor on the spar line, just outboard of D7's spar cradle and lid pillar (y 0.17-0.23, CR-D3-11): C4-R3 modelled the brace at this anchor (CL-C4-D3-BRACE-F, CL-C4-D3-SEP 0.39); lateral stiffness CL-D3-BRACE-KY is information only; clear of the elevons (x < 0.2496) and the pod

engage_m.note: strip end bonded into the ear and the anchor slots

len_x_m.note: printed saddle on the spar top, through a 20 x 16 mm pocket in the core and skin (CR-D3-03 to D1)

proud_m.note: above the skin, holds the brace slot

w_m.note: pultruded CF strip 10 x 1 mm on both faces of each half-fin along the sloped top edge, from the tube surface (inside the collar tail) to the square tip

pin_d_m.note: R5: pultruded CF rod 2.5 mm at the drawn 15 mm pitch, 2.5 mm drill, epoxy injected before the pin (CL-C6-STRIP-PIN-RF-PROP 1.59 at 72.7 N, 1.25 at 92 N). Fallback only if 2.5 mm rod cannot be bought: 2 mm at 9 mm pitch (CL-C6-STRIP-PIN-RF-ALT)

pin_pitch_m.note: D-90: 15 -> 12 mm. C4 R5 pin force on the D-65 loads 131 N at 15 mm (CL-C4-D3-STRIP-PIN-F) gives the 2.5 mm pin RF 0.88 and a largest pitch of 13.2 mm (bending bound); 12 mm gives RF 1.10. Along the strip, first pin half a pitch aft of the collar tail

height_m.note: keyhole boss on the block, above the upper skin and below the lower skin: lengthens the tube bore 27 -> 47 mm (root fixity) and holds the board root LE in its slot (replaces separate root clips)

tail_m.note: board engagement aft of the tube surface

slot_clear_m.note: per side, board in the clip slot

len_m.note: tab beyond the boss ring, outboard side (y), one eye per fin root (CR-H1-08); separate part FIN-013 bonded after the spar bond since D-89c (SW-01: printed on the block it stopped the block entering its pocket)

h_m.note: above the upper skin / below the lower skin

t_m.note: along x, centred on the tube axis

hole_d_m.note: cord or 3.6 mm cable tie; hole axis along x

hole_y_m.note: hole centre outboard of the ring outer radius

bond_line_m.note: saddle foot inner radius = boss outer radius + this; thickened epoxy fills it

foot_t_m.note: saddle foot wall round the boss

foot_deg.note: half-angle of the saddle foot about +y (outboard), clear of the boss tail slot walls

skin_stack_m.source: subsystems/wing/params.json#skin.model_t_m (0.1 mm) x 3 layers (wing.py skin_plan: block doubler on 2 layers) + 0.02 mm
skin_stack_m.note: D-89c: the eye foot sits on the skin tape, bonded after the skin (BUILD-GUIDE 6.6), so it stands this far off the core surface

x_m.note: centre of the ESC-lead hole through every half-fin; 8 mm aft of the boss tail (x 0.074), 0 mm overlap with the ESC pad (z 0.104-0.132)

off_skin_m.note: hole centre above the upper skin / below the lower skin at x_m. F2 asked 10 mm; raised so the hole edge (18 mm) and the grommet flange (17 mm) clear the 12 mm root fillet and the 15 mm skin-tape lap (CL-D3-WIRE-HOLE-CLEAR)

d_m.note: drilled after laminating; F2 bonds a printed ASA grommet 10/7 mm (harness part, CA)

slot_x_m.note: tie slot along x, for a 2.5 x 100 mm cable tie

slot_y_m.note: tie slot normal to the face

skin_m.note: printed skin between the slot and the face it stands on

bar_m.note: outer bar over the slot (3 perimeters at 0.4 mm)

post_m.note: posts each side of the slot along x

embed_m.note: lug sunk into the face it stands on (one body in the print)

h_m.note: lug height along z; slot open at both ends

boss_x_m.note: boss-tail lug centre, inboard face of the bore-boss slot wall, upper and lower boss (E-HRN-03/05)

boss_clear_m.note: gap between the skin and the lug so the tie turns under it

collar_x_m.note: R5: collar-tail phase-lead lug centre x 0.060 (was 0.084), outboard face of the outboard tail wall, slot OPEN ALONG X (the phase bundle runs up the face along z there); 5 mm long along x (0.0575-0.0625), front 2.1 mm aft of the ring at the wall plane; F2 free span 0.047 m <= 0.050 (CL-F2-FREE-SPAN). E-HRN-06...09

collar_drop_m.note: R5: lug top 1.5 mm below the tail top edge at the lug front (F2)
